question: Which 3 artists have sold the most tracks in total by quantity, and how many units did each sell?
sql:
SELECT
    Artist.Name,
    SUM(InvoiceLine.Quantity) AS TotalUnits
FROM
    InvoiceLine
JOIN
    Track ON InvoiceLine.TrackId = Track.TrackId
JOIN
    Album ON Track.AlbumId = Album.AlbumId
JOIN
    Artist ON Album.ArtistId = Artist.ArtistId
GROUP BY
    Artist.ArtistId,
    Artist.Name
ORDER BY
    TotalUnits DESC
LIMIT 3;
